page.layout: One printed page, title page: all lines centred in one block, with a woodcut device in the centre and the printer's imprint below. No margin text. A handwritten shelfmark and page marks at the top right and bottom right are not printed text.

l.i: Iuxta, quibus noti ac notati, varietate delectifica locu-

page.notes: The title is set in mixed roman and italic capitals. Handwritten marks ("83.8 hu (1)" and the page numbers "1" and "2") are not printed and are left out. The device shows a winged horse, caduceus and clouds; it is described here, not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "inutiamque", "delectifica", "locu-pletius", "antefatio", "selectiorum", which are printed as seen. Lines with a hyphen end at a line break.
